fb57b628ce6a2539cb0940127763744e47be19bf.title: Drone Remote ID Profiles (49 tests)
fb57b628ce6a2539cb0940127763744e47be19bf.summary: Adds 10 synthetic DJI, Autel and Parrot Remote ID profiles, generic BLE4 Remote ID, Wi-Fi beacon formats, and negative/partial-data cases. Does not clone actual aircraft radios.
highlights: DJI Mini, Air, Mavic, Phantom and Matrice; Autel EVO II, EVO Max and EVO Lite; Parrot ANAFI and ANAFI USA test labels.
49 selectable scenarios, including synthetic BLE Remote ID and 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi Remote ID beacon tests.
New invalid, shortened, old-location and missing-operator test cases.
BLE5 coded/extended and Wi-Fi NAN are offline-only fixtures, not live radio transmissions.

6c08d0de80c0206a08ba99eaab4c324400a35bff.title: RF Test Matrix + S3 Packaging (31 tests)
6c08d0de80c0206a08ba99eaab4c324400a35bff.summary: Contains the same 31 on-air detection scenarios as e5cf01bf. Improves the ESP32-S3 firmware artifact packaging for browser installation; no new C5 RF tests compared with e5cf01bf.
highlights: 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi channel 1, 6 and 11 detection and benign-negative controls.
Additional BLE iBeacon identity and malformed/near-match detection cases.
Per-CYD accuracy scoring and paired serial evidence capture.
Complete S3 flash parts now built for future browser installer support.

e5cf01bf40a796f50750b37b1777da0273da92f1.title: RF Test Matrix (31 tests)
e5cf01bf40a796f50750b37b1777da0273da92f1.summary: Initial expansion from 22 to 31 RF scenarios with Wi-Fi channel-specific tests, additional BLE negative controls and per-CYD verification tools.
highlights: Wi-Fi channel 6/11 AXON, FLOCK and benign AP test profiles.
Second iBeacon identity and malformed iBeacon, Remote ID UUID and Meta UUID negatives.
Independent offline Remote ID/iBeacon checks.
Separate SquachWatch 2.8 and 3.2 accuracy reports and paired USB serial evidence.

2d6e9f3f29b51b30d1b5731bc7b220e7d020312f.title: C5 Touchscreen Baseline (22 tests)
2d6e9f3f29b51b30d1b5731bc7b220e7d020312f.summary: Initial ESP32-C5 Waveshare 2.8-inch touchscreen support with 22 synthetic BLE and Wi-Fi RF scenarios; no later channel matrix or drone-model profile expansion.
highlights: Waveshare C5 ST7789 display and CST3530 touch GUI.
Original 22 opt-in RF detection test cases.
BLE Remote ID generic, iBeacon, tracker and Wi-Fi SSID test scenarios.

ee7295ac58d3e159036fae76b964644a202d9838.title: ESP32-S3 Baseline (22 tests)
ee7295ac58d3e159036fae76b964644a202d9838.summary: Original ESP32-S3 22-case bounded BLE and Wi-Fi lab transmitter, before the channel-specific and drone-model profile expansions.
highlights: Original BLE tracker, iBeacon, generic Remote ID and Wi-Fi SSID detection tests.
Serial RUN / SUITE / STOP control; no RF transmission on boot.
No C5 display support or new model-specific Remote ID test profiles.

2774856ec2c0f852eb87b1ec99dfcb910aadca7e.title: CYD 3.2 ST7798 Emitter (49 tests)
2774856ec2c0f852eb87b1ec99dfcb910aadca7e.summary: First SquachEmit build for ESP32-2432S032R 3.2-inch ST7798-compatible resistive CYD. Adds on-screen RF scenario control, persistent touch calibration, and all 49 synthetic Remote ID / RF test cases. Replaces SquachWatch on the flashed device.
highlights: Supports owner's 3.2-inch ESP32-WROOM-32 CYD ST7798-compatible TFT, XPT2046 touch, and GPIO27 backlight.
49 controlled on-air tests including 10 synthetic DJI/Autel/Parrot drone Remote ID lab profiles.
On-device PREV/NEXT, RUN/STOP/SUITE and five-point touch calibration saved in a separate NVS namespace.
Uses 115200 baud SquachEmit serial and classic ESP32 2.4GHz Wi-Fi/BLE4 hardware.
Flashing overwrites SquachWatch on this physical CYD; use a second CYD receiver.

471699cb08ad7e458b4d56a11e1f5ef265d54ed5.title: CYD 3.2 ST7798 Smooth UI (49 tests)
471699cb08ad7e458b4d56a11e1f5ef265d54ed5.summary: Updated SquachEmit 3.2-inch CYD ST7798/XPT2046 firmware: 49 RF test cases, onboard UI and persistent touch calibration. Redraws only the running countdown instead of refreshing the entire screen each second; prevents a blocking calibration from extending RF transmissions. Replaces SquachWatch on the flashed board.
highlights: ESP32-2432S032R 3.2-inch ST7798/ST7789-compatible TFT, XPT2046 touch, GPIO27 backlight and classic ESP32 4MB flash.
49 synthetic BLE/Wi-Fi tests including DJI Mini/Air/Mavic/Phantom/Matrice, Autel EVO and Parrot ANAFI Remote ID profiles.
New touchscreen PREV/NEXT, RUN/STOP/SUITE, persistent five-point calibration and CALTOUCH serial recovery.
Reduced screen flicker: running countdown updates only its small timer region instead of clearing the entire display.
Touch calibration is blocked during active RF or suite mode, so a wizard cannot extend timed emissions.
Flashing replaces the SquachWatch app on this board; use a separate device to receive test signals.

caa89d82047b73cecfbd9d9b476c7bc2fa2a14bb.title: SquachEmit 3.2 — Squachy Animated UI (Latest LAB)
caa89d82047b73cecfbd9d9b476c7bc2fa2a14bb.summary: Newest 3.2-inch ST7798 SquachEmit LAB: ports SquachWatch GPLv3-derived core Squachy appearance and movements into an isolated sprite, removes oversized status text over Squachy and retains the earlier color-inversion and unique BLE/Wi-Fi MAC fixes. This is a first core-character port, not the entire original animation/costume/speech engine. Hardware unverified.
highlights: Source-derived SquachWatch default Squachy proportions, hair, sunglasses, blink, wave, bounce, walk, dance, sleep and startled expressions.
Animates only a 112x111 offscreen patch (~24KB heap); static fallback if allocation fails, pending real ST7798 verification.
Retains display polarity override (COLORS, INVERT ON/OFF), local scenario-specific BLE/Wi-Fi MACs (IDENTITY) and 49 RF scenarios.
Serial console supports selectable baud rates; device firmware serial default is 115200.
GPLv3-derived port requires GPLv3-compliant distribution of linked firmware; this LAB is not a hardware-approved release.

774e2c8cc3077c7ae07a534d9519e0774cb51e25.title: SquachEmit 3.2 — Expanded Detection Matrix (95 Cases) + Squachy Animated UI
774e2c8cc3077c7ae07a534d9519e0774cb51e25.summary: Adds 46 opt-in synthetic BLE/Wi-Fi variants and negative controls to the 49-case Squachy Animated UI LAB, for 95 total scenarios. Covers Flock battery, Snap/Luxottica/Meta IDs, Raven, Tile, Flipper, serial-module names, Axon AB3/AB4, Pineapple Pager, additional Wi-Fi channels and Remote ID beacons; corrects the Eddystone-only Google false positive. The CYD3.2 UI now displays the live catalog count. Hardware not yet verified.
highlights: 95 synthetic time-limited on-air tests with separate per-case locally-administered MAC identities; zero RF emission at boot.
More SquachWatch family variants: Flock, Meta/Snap/Luxottica, Raven, Tile, Flipper, Axon, generic Bluetooth serial-module candidates and Pineapple Pager.
Negative controls for spoofable names, neighboring UUIDs/company IDs, Flockhart/Pager prefixes and generic Eddystone (0xFEAA).
Wi-Fi channels 1/3/9/11 plus Remote ID SoftAP beacon tests on channels 1/11; BLE legacy, not BLE5 extended or Bluetooth Classic.
Retains core SquachWatch-derived Squachy animated UI and prior ST7798 inversion control; source-derived GPLv3 component is subject to GPLv3 distribution obligations.
Manufacturer OUI, Pwnagotchi, deauth/evil twin and NAN receiver cases are offline fixtures, not forged on-air management traffic.

04e380aa373cf2c4e02950f9076eb0355f7a7f98.title: SquachEmit 3.2 — Device-Type Test Library (95 Cases) + Squachy
04e380aa373cf2c4e02950f9076eb0355f7a7f98.summary: Reorganizes the 95-case SquachEmit CYD 3.2 test library into 10 exclusive device-type categories. Categories and case IDs are alphabetical. Drone cases remain in Drones regardless of BLE or Wi-Fi transport. Retains the Squachy animated UI, corrected ST7798 colors and the same synthetic RF tests. Hardware unverified.
highlights: Ten alphabetical device-type groups: Axon, Drones / Remote ID, Flock, General / Controls, Hacker Devices, iBeacon, Raven, Serial Modules, Smart Glasses and Trackers.
Exactly one category for each of the 95 scenarios. Device-group variants and their near-match negative controls remain together.
PREV/NEXT category paging; alphabetically sorted test IDs within each category.
BLE/Wi-Fi carrier remains in technical details, not a separate duplicated category.
Retains Squachy animated character, bounded emissions, per-case synthetic MAC identity and browser-based flashing.
No physical hardware verification yet. No receiver firmware changes.

ffc08d1b65bf261ec4dad7bb6b44da05650ad98e.title: SquachEmit CYD 3.2 — 172-Case UAV Vendor Suite + Smooth Touch
ffc08d1b65bf261ec4dad7bb6b44da05650ad98e.summary: Adds 27 UAS manufacturer-prefix Wi-Fi beacon tests to reach 172 scenarios. The CYD 3.2 has a saved 3–30-second TX-time editor and reduced full-screen touch flashing. These are synthetic signal tests; an OUI match alone does not prove aircraft identity.
highlights: 172 bounded synthetic BLE/Wi-Fi test cases, including 27 vendor-prefix Wi-Fi beacons.
CYD 3.2 TX TIME [SET]: +/-1 second, reset to 12 seconds, saved on reboot.
Touch interactions no longer cause unnecessary full-screen redraws.
RUN, SUITE and serial RUN without an explicit time use the saved duration.
Uses locally administered test MACs; vendor registrations are not authentic drone broadcasts.

09b4b0519eb411391a51a0ea6dc5283428d3f62f.title: SquachEmit Mainline — 172-Case Suite + Safe Flasher + TX Time
09b4b0519eb411391a51a0ea6dc5283428d3f62f.summary: Mainline 172-case detection test firmware with UAV vendor-prefix beacon cases, CYD 3.2 saved 3–30-second TX time and reduced redraws. The web installer verifies four flash segments by SHA-256, and README animations were regenerated from current C++ UI. This is not the original tagged v1.0.0 95-case firmware.
highlights: 172 synthetic scenarios, including 27 UAV vendor-prefix test beacons.
CYD 3.2 saved TX-time editor and touch flashing fix.
Installer verifies bootloader, partitions, OTA and application checksums.
Four current firmware-rendered README animations, including TX-time demo.
This mainline CI build is not the historical v1.0.0 release.

ff8bf732aa92406d11610142e6a71cb7021be1a6.title: SquachEmit Mainline — 172-Test Suite + SHA-256 Safe Flasher
ff8bf732aa92406d11610142e6a71cb7021be1a6.summary: 172-case firmware with UAV vendor beacon tests and saved CYD 3.2 transmit time. Adds web installer SHA-256 verification of bootloader, partition table, OTA selector and application before flashing. Not the historical tagged v1.0.0 95-case image.
highlights: 172 bounded BLE/Wi-Fi synthetic test cases.
CYD 3.2 saved 3–30-second transmit duration and reduced redraws.
Four-segment firmware SHA-256 verification before flashing.

b1755ef84bc4d9ba86c73a472c7750407a04c7d4.title: SquachEmit Mainline — 172-Case UAV Beacon Suite + TX Time
b1755ef84bc4d9ba86c73a472c7750407a04c7d4.summary: Merged the 172-case UAV vendor-prefix test matrix, 3–30-second saved transmit duration and CYD 3.2 no-full-screen-touch-flash improvement. This commit predates the new four-segment installer integrity feature.
highlights: 172 bounded test cases including 27 UAS vendor Wi-Fi beacons.
Saved CYD 3.2 TX-time editor and improved touch redraw behavior.
Synthetic test identities are not authentic vendor devices.
